_doc: Supercool hero (BIBLE.md cast row): a man in his early thirties, average build, short dark hair, light stubble, big expressive eyes that do the comedy (eyeSize 1.02, browThick 1.4 — lines 9 and 25 live on the brows); a rust-orange long-sleeve shirt (open overshirt) over a white tee, dark jeans; no hat, no glasses — nothing between his face and the camera. Started from specs/br_guy (same family), retuned to the bible's numbers: medium W .80, legLen 1.28, armLen .95.
